list.delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? It will be removed from the list and its canvas will no longer open.
list.updated_hint: Local registry update time, not the canvas save time or a run timestamp.

status_hint.published: View released versions in the publish log.
status_hint.unpublished: No published version yet. Open the canvas to keep building.
status_hint.unknown: Publication status could not be read. This does not mean unpublished. Refresh to retry.
status_hint.pending_delete: Deletion in progress. Editing and publishing are unavailable.

form.desc_too_long: Description must be at most 2000 characters

list.load_failed_hint: Please retry; if it keeps failing, contact your organization administrator.
list.unauthorized_hint: Your account or the active organization no longer has access to workflows. Switch organization or ask an administrator to grant access — retrying will not help.
list.no_workflows_hint: Click "New Workflow" to create your first workflow

unbound.title: Workflow space not initialized yet
unbound.description: This organization has no workflow space yet, so the workflow list is unavailable. Click the button below to initialize it — the space name is taken from your organization name, there is nothing to fill in, and clicking again simply returns the existing space.

degraded.title: Upstream not ready
degraded.description: The workflow app bound to this organization is marked unavailable upstream, so workflows cannot be read right now. Contact an administrator, then retry.

list.initialize_failed: Could not initialize the workflow space. Please retry; if it keeps failing, contact your organization administrator.
list.initialize_failed_session: The platform workflow account is unavailable right now, so initialization did not finish. Please retry later or contact your organization administrator.
list.initialize_failed_upstream: The upstream service is temporarily unavailable and initialization did not finish. Please retry later.
list.initialize_failed_unauthorized: This session is not allowed to initialize a workflow space. Sign in again, then retry.

delete_refused.reviewing: This workflow is under first-release review and cannot be deleted yet. Check the review result in the canvas, then retry.
delete_refused.unpublish_required: This workflow must be unpublished in the canvas before it can be deleted.
delete_refused.unknown: The upstream service does not allow deleting this workflow right now. Check its release state in the canvas, then retry.

timeout.title: Canvas initialization timed out
timeout.description: The canvas did not finish initializing within 10 seconds. The upstream service may be busy or the network slow. Please retry.

loadFailed.title: Canvas failed to load
loadFailed.description: The canvas page could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry.

handshakeFailed.title: Canvas session could not be established
handshakeFailed.description: Access credentials were not delivered to the canvas, so the workflow was not opened. Please retry.

canvasError.title: Canvas error
canvasError.description: The canvas reported an internal error and editing cannot continue.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.description: The canvas credentials expired and cannot be renewed. Sign in again and reopen the workflow from the list.

unbound.title: Workflow space not initialized yet
unbound.description: This organization has no workflow space yet, so the canvas cannot be opened. Initialize it on the workflow list page, then retry.

degraded.title: Upstream not ready
degraded.description: The workflow app bound to this organization is marked unavailable upstream, so the canvas cannot be opened right now. Contact an administrator, then retry.

spaceMissing.title: Upstream not ready
spaceMissing.description: The platform workflow account's space is still initializing, so the canvas cannot be opened yet. This page retries automatically in a moment; if it keeps failing, contact your organization administrator.

probeFailed.title: Upstream state unknown
probeFailed.description: Reading the tenant binding or platform account failed, so the canvas was not opened. Please retry.

log.title: Publish log · {{name}}
log.description: Publish records and the current version come from the upstream workflow engine; console-side publish actions are shown from the platform audit log under "Platform publish actions" below.
log.failed_hint: The publish records and current version could not be read from upstream. Please retry later.
log.empty_hint: Publish records come from publishing the workflow space to channels (upstream app-level endpoint). Console-side publishes appear under "Platform publish actions" below.

run.title: Run log
run.description: Run records come from the upstream workflow engine and are not stored by the platform. The left column lists runs by execution ID with their status; pick one to see that run's input parameters and output result on the right.
run.description_scoped: This workflow's run records come from the upstream workflow engine and are not stored by the platform. The left column lists runs by execution ID with their status; pick one to see that run's input parameters and output result on the right.
run.failed_unauthorized: This session is not allowed to view run records. Sign in again, then retry.
run.failed_not_found: The selected workflow no longer exists in the workflow space. Refresh the list, then retry.
run.failed_unbound: This organization has no workflow space yet. Initialize it on the list page first.
run.failed_degraded: The workflow app bound to this organization is marked unavailable upstream, so run records cannot be read right now. Contact an administrator, then retry.
run.failed_account_not_provisioned: The platform workflow account is not ready yet, so run records cannot be read. Please retry later; if it keeps failing, contact your organization administrator.
run.failed_session: The platform workflow account is unavailable right now and run records could not be read. Please retry later or contact your organization administrator.
run.failed_timeout: The upstream service timed out and run records could not be read. Please retry later.
run.failed_upstream: The upstream service rejected this read. Please retry later; if it keeps failing, contact your organization administrator.
run.failed: Could not load run records. Please retry.
run.empty_title: No run records for this workflow yet
run.empty_hint: The upstream engine has no execution for this workflow in the last 7 days — rows appear here after it runs once.
run.scope_hint: Scanned the run records of {{scanned}} of {{total}} workflows; workflows created earlier are not included.
run.truncated_hint: There are more records; only the most recent {{count}} are shown.
run.upstream_more_hint: The upstream engine caps how many records it returns per workflow; earlier runs may exist but are not shown.
run.platform_title: Runs triggered by the platform (external API)
run.platform_hint: From the platform's own call log; canvas-side test runs do not go through the platform and are not listed here.
run.platform_no_io: Platform-triggered runs only leave a call record on the platform side; the upstream engine has no input parameters or output result for them.
run.detail_unavailable: The upstream engine provided no execution ID or owning workflow for these runs, so their input and output cannot be opened.
run.io_failed_title: Could not load input and output

api.title: Call API · {{name}}
api.description: External systems can trigger this workflow with a console API key. The platform only authenticates, checks ownership and forwards the request — it does no business processing.
api.copy_failed: Copy failed — select the text and copy it manually
api.auth_hint: Create a key on the console's API Keys page (the plaintext is shown once) and send it in the Authorization header:
api.example_sync: Synchronous call (waits for the run and returns its output)
api.example_async: Asynchronous call (returns executeId immediately; check the result in the upstream debug page)
api.param_parameters: Workflow inputs: a JSON object, or its JSON string; omit to run without parameters.
api.param_is_async: true returns executeId immediately; false (default) waits for the run and returns data.
api.param_ext: Optional runtime user identity forwarded to the upstream run; when omitted the upstream platform account is used.
api.params_note: The published version is what runs: an unpublished workflow returns 409 (WORKFLOW_NOT_PUBLISHED), a missing or foreign workflow returns 404, and the key must belong to the organization that owns the workflow.
